flores_passage: "Technological determinism ek aisaa shabd hai, jo practice mein vichaaron ki ek wide range ko encompass karta hai, technology-push ya technique imperative se lekar sakht sense tak ki human niyati scientific kanunon aur technology mein unke manifestation se judey ek antarnihit tark se prerit hai. Technique determinism ke zyaadaatar interpretations do general ideas ke baare mein bataati hain: technique vikas par cultural or political influence ka koi bhi effects nahin padta hai and parinamswarup samajik roop se anukoolit hone ke bajaay wah takneek nihit societies ko ""prabhaavit"" karti hai. Udaaharan ke liye, koi keh sakta hai ki motor car aavashyak roop se sadkon ke development ko prabhaavit karti hain. However, nationwide mein bichh sadkon ka jaal sirf mutthibhar cars ke liye kifaayati nahin tha, so car ownership ka cost reduce karne ke liye production ke naye-new methods viksit kiye gaye. Roads par zyada durghatna ki bahut zyada kar ownership hai, jisse shareer mein hui toot-foot ko sudhaarne ke liye healthcare meinnei technique ke aavishkar ko badhaava milaa hai."

flores_passage: "MRI ek physics ghatna par adharit hai jise nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR)  jata hai, jiski khoj 1930 ke dashak mein felix baloch (stanford vishvavidyalaya mein karyarat) and Edward Parsel (Harvard vishvavidyalaya) ne ki thi. Is anunaad mein, chumbakiya field aur radio tarangen parmaanuon ko chhote radio signals ko chhodne ka karan bante hain. Saal 1970 mein, medical doctor aur anusandhaan vaigyaanik Raymond Damadian ne chikitsa nidan ke liye ek upkaran ke roop mein magnetic anunaad imaging ka istemal karne ke liye basis ki khoj ki. Chaar saal baad koi patent diya gaya. yah meri ke field mein jaari kiya gaya world ka pahala patent tha. 1977 mein, Dr. Damadian ne sabse pehle ""pure body par"" MRI scanner ke sanrachana ka construction kiya, jise unhone ""adamya"" naam diya."
